jobs.title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.


About the Role

We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering.

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations, lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy and the stack

  • Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

  • Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

  • Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

  • Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

  • Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

  • Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

  • Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

  • Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

  • Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

  • Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

  • Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

  • Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

  • Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

  • Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

  • Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

  • Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

  • Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

  • Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful

Experience

  • Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

  • Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

  • Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

  • Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

  • Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

  • Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

  • Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct

  • You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

  • You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

  • You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

  • Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

  • Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

  • Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The opportunity

We are seeking a Talent Acquisition Partner: an individual who is passionate about enabling a product-led organisation by engaging and hiring talented members across all different Business areas.

What you will do:

  • Own hiring end-to-end, from intake through offer, across the Business as your primary area of depth.

  • Work as a peer to hiring managers and GTM leadership: run intakes that sharpen unclear requirements, push back when a profile isn't hireable, calibrate on candidates, and hold the process to a standard when timelines get tight.

  • Develop sourcing strategies for talent that rarely applies passive outreach, Boolean, referrals, networking, and competitive intelligence across travel tech, marketplaces, and B2B SaaS.

  • Maintain pipelines for critical and recurring roles, so we're not starting from zero each time a req opens.

  • Coach hiring managers on interviewing and keep our assessment consistent as teams grow.

  • Use hiring data, funnel conversion, time-to-hire, and source effectiveness to change how we hire, not just to report on it.

  • Keep the ATS accurate and support employer branding in the communities we hire from.

Workplace: Berlin & Hybrid



Who you are:

  • 5+ years in talent acquisition, in-house, with demonstrable full-cycle ownership: you've sourced, assessed, negotiated, and closed senior hires yourself.

  • You can hold a credible conversation about discovery, roadmaps, and metrics, and judge whether a candidate's story about impact holds up.

  • Breadth across Tech and Business hiring alongside that depth.

  • Strong stakeholder management with senior hiring managers. You can redirect a stalled search, challenge a hiring manager, and deliver difficult market news without damaging the relationship.

  • A proven pipeline of both active and passive candidates, with rapport built throughout and offers closed at the end.

  • Data fluency: you can build a funnel view and use it to make an argument.

  • You have a curious mindset, always testing and adapting your search approach, driven by finding the right talent — and open to 360-degree feedback as a way to keep growing.

  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, global, diverse start-up environment, and open to feedback.

  • You have a curious mindset and an interest in research; open to 360-degree feedback and looking to grow.

  • Tools affinity, keeping our ATS updated, and data accurate.

  • You are fluent in English, both verbally and in writing.

What you can expect:

  • Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.

  • Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.

  • Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.

  • Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com, Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.

  • Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow.

Account Executive
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in United Kingdom.

This is a highly technical sales role focused on helping engineering teams adopt infrastructure and developer-focused technology.
You will own opportunities from initial engagement through close, working directly with technically sophisticated customers who expect credibility and speed.
The role combines consultative selling, technical problem-solving, proof-of-concept management, and disciplined pipeline ownership.
You will work closely with Solutions Engineers while becoming a trusted presence in customer communication channels and helping remove obstacles to purchase.
Success requires the confidence to explain complex concepts simply, challenge assumptions, and be transparent when a solution is not the right fit.
You will operate with significant autonomy in a fast-moving environment where experimentation, urgency, and customer outcomes matter.
This is an opportunity for either an experienced technical AE or a technically minded professional ready to take ownership of a sales quota.


Accountabilities
  • Own the sales process from qualified opportunity through successful close, with a strong focus on helping technical customers achieve their desired outcomes.
  • Build trusted relationships with engineers and technical stakeholders, including actively participating in customer communication channels such as Slack.
  • Manage and close inbound sales opportunities, moving prospects efficiently through the buying process.
  • Lead and coordinate proof-of-concept initiatives in partnership with Solutions Engineers, ensuring technical and commercial objectives are clearly defined.
  • Help customers troubleshoot questions and remove technical or commercial obstacles that could prevent a successful purchase.
  • Communicate honestly and transparently, including clearly explaining when a solution is not an appropriate fit.
  • Maintain a systematic approach to pipeline management, ensuring opportunities, next steps, and follow-ups are consistently tracked.
  • Navigate, improve, and contribute to internal sales and go-to-market systems and processes.
  • Experiment with new approaches to prospect engagement, deal execution, and GTM workflows, using results and customer feedback to continuously improve.
  • Move quickly and independently, identifying what needs to be done and taking action without requiring detailed direction.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience as an Account Executive, particularly in a technical B2B, SaaS, infrastructure, or developer-focused sales environment; alternatively, strong technical experience combined with readiness to take on a sales quota.
    • Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to comfortably understand API documentation, technical product concepts, and engineering workflows.
    • Experience selling to developers or engineering teams is highly desirable, with an understanding of how to build credibility with technically sophisticated buyers.
    • Strong organizational and pipeline-management skills, with a systematic approach to tracking opportunities and following through on commitments.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely.
    • High integrity and customer orientation, with a commitment to honest communication rather than overselling.
    • Strong sense of urgency and ability to operate at the pace of technically sophisticated, fast-moving customers.
    • Self-directed and resourceful, with the ability to take ownership and make progress without extensive supervision.
    • Curious and experimental mindset, with a willingness to test new approaches, learn from unsuccessful experiments, and adapt quickly.
    • Experience with databases, search technologies, or infrastructure software is a plus.
    • Familiarity with GTM automation tools such as Clay or n8n is advantageous.
    • Comfort working with Python, JavaScript, Linux, or major cloud platforms is a plus.
    • Willingness to prioritize correctness, customer evidence, initiative, and continuous improvement in day-to-day decision-making.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote working environment.
      • Opportunity to work from Canada, the United States, or Europe.
      • Significant autonomy and ownership over your work.
      • Direct exposure to highly technical customers and engineering teams.
      • Opportunity to work closely with Solutions Engineers and technical stakeholders.
      • Chance to develop expertise across databases, search, infrastructure, and developer-focused technology.
      • Fast-moving environment that encourages experimentation and learning from results.
      • Opportunity to influence and improve internal go-to-market systems and processes.
      • Role with direct commercial impact and responsibility for closing meaningful technical deals.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager Service Subscriptions (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir suchen

...als Senior Product Manager Aftersales Subscriptions (m/w/d). Du übernimmst die Produktverantwortung für unser Service- und Wartungsabo. Dein Fokus liegt darauf, das Portfolio von der Tarifstruktur über den Leistungsumfang bis zur Preisgestaltung so zu entwickeln, dass es für unsere Kund:innen einen klaren Mehrwert bietet und zugleich wiederkehrende Umsätze sowie ein profitables Aftersales-Geschäft schafft.


Wenn Du daran Spaß hast

  • unser Service- und Wartungsportfolio end-to-end zu verantworten: von Tarifstufen und Leistungsversprechen über Service-Level bis zur Abgrenzung zwischen enthaltenen und separat berechneten Leistungen
  • die wirtschaftliche Grundlage des Produkts zu bauen und zu verteidigen: Tarifstruktur, Preise, Deckungsbeitrag, Kosten pro Vertrag, Rückstellungen, Break-even, Indexierung und Kündigungslogik festzulegen sowie über die wesentlichen Bausteine des Produkts als Make-or-Buy-Entscheidung zu befinden, von der langfristigen Absicherung über die Abrechnung bis zum Tooling
  • das Abo aus dem bisherigen Aftersales-Prozess in den Angebotsmoment zu bringen und Sales sowie Service mit Argumentation, Materialien und klaren Abläufen auszustatten
  • gemeinsam mit Legal und externen Berater:innen Verträge, Bedingungen und Kundentexte zu entwickeln, die auch im Detail belastbar sind
  • Anforderungen an Checkout, CRM, Vertragsdatenmodell, Berechtigungslogik, Abrechnung und Mahnwesen zu definieren, bestehende Verträge zu migrieren und das Produkt weiterzuentwickeln


Und Dich hier wiedererkennst

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium: idealerweise in BWL, Volkswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Fach. Ein anderer Werdegang mit passender Praxiserfahrung ist ebenfalls willkommen. 
  • Product Ownership: Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mindestens drei Jahre im Produktmanagement eines kommerziell verantworteten Abo-, Service- oder Vertragsprodukts. Du hast Preise festgelegt, Margen verantwortet und die Folgen deiner Entscheidungen an Churn, Schadensfällen oder Servicekosten gesehen
  • Commercial & Quantitative Depth: Du entwickelst und prüfst Business Cases selbst. Dabei erkennst du, welche Annahme das Modell kippen kann, und leitest daraus klare Entscheidungen ab
  • AI-First: Du nutzt KI- und Low-Code-Tools, um Prototypen, Automatisierungen und erste Lösungen selbst zu bauen. Du weißt zugleich, an welcher Stelle echte Engineering-Kapazität nötig ist
  • Vertragsverständnis: Du arbeitest präzise mit Legal und externen Berater:innen und erkennst früh, welche kommerzielle Idee rechtlich oder regulatorisch angepasst werden muss
  • Arbeitsweise: Du gehst in die Serviceorganisation, liest Claims- und Servicedaten und sprichst mit den Menschen, die das Produkt im Alltag ausführen. Auch bei Widerspruch hältst du eine begründete Position und änderst sie, wenn die Fakten es verlangen
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau und gute Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau
Tiefes Wärmepumpen- oder Heizungswissen ist keine Voraussetzung und wird im Prozess nicht bewertet. Diese Tiefe haben wir im Haus. Was wir suchen, ist Produktverantwortung für ein Abo-Geschäft und die Fähigkeit, selbst zu bauen.


Was wir Dir bieten

  • Das Bruttojahresgehalt für diese Position startet ab 80.000€ bis 92.000€*
  • Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Menschen quer durch die Gesellschaft zusammenbringt – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter oder Hintergrund.
  • Ein modernes Office mitten in Berlin-Kreuzberg mit Dachterrasse, in dem auch Hunde willkommen sind.
  • Monatliche Unternehmensevents wie Lunch & Learn und Drinks & Action.
  • Bilde Dich weiter! Regelmäßige Möglichkeiten für Trainings und Fortbildungen durch unser eigenes Learning & Development Team oder externe Coaches.
  • Beweg Dich mit Deinem JobRad, klimafreundlich durch die Stadt.
  • Die Möglichkeit, dein persönliches Wunsch-Elektroauto bequem mıt FINN JobAuto Leasing.
  • Corporate Benefits: Mitarbeiterrabatte bei über 100 Partner:innen.
  • Dein Wohlbefinden ist uns wichtig, daher investieren wir für dich in deine physische sowie psychische Gesundheit und bieten dir neben 30 Tagen Urlaub und weiteren zahlreiche Vergünstigungen über die Corporate Benefits auch eine vergünstigte Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft und Zugang zu nilo.health, einer Plattform zur mentalen Gesundheitsvorsorge.
  • Sicherheit & Vorsorge: Wir bieten Dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag und sorgen für Deine Zukunft: Dein Beitrag zur bAV und BUV wird durch einen erhöhten Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 20% unterstützt.


Über uns

Jede Bewerbung ist willkommen bei uns - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, sexueller Orientierung oder Identität. Wir sind überzeugt, jeder Mensch ist wertvoll und verdient eine faire Chance.

Kein Haus gleicht dem anderen, aber für jeden von uns ist es ein Zuhause. Es steht für das, was uns ausmacht, was uns wichtig ist. Hier wollen wir seit jeher geborgen, sicher und ungestört sein.

Aber wir glauben, beim eigenen Heim geht es künftig um mehr - nämlich um die Generationen, die nach uns kommen. Wir glauben, unsere Häuser können mehr! Sie können elektrifiziert, intelligent, effizient, unabhängig und klimaneutral sein. Wir glauben, klimaneutrales Wohnen sollte für jeden zugänglich, erschwinglich und einfach sein. Und mit jeder Wärmepumpe vor unseren Häusern, jeder Photovoltaikanlage auf unseren Dächern und jeder Wallbox in unseren Garagen leisten wir einen Beitrag für klimaneutrales Wohnen.

Wir glauben nicht nur an klimaneutrales Wohnen – wir ermöglichen es.
Für Millionen von Eigenheimen. Gemeinsam. Jeden Tag. Heim für Heim.


Dein Bewerbungsprozess

  • Überzeugt Dein CV? Dann gehst Du mit Vanessa (Talent Acquistion Manager) in einen ersten Austausch**.
  • Besteht von beiden Seiten Interesse, steigst Du mit Thomas (Chief Innovation Officer) tiefer in die Position ein und bekommst Du die Möglichkeit, eine Case Study durchzuführen, uns diese vorzustellen.
  • Abschließend bist Du in einem finalen Gespräch mit einigen deiner potenzieller Teamkollegen
  • Sind alle glücklich? Herzlich willkommen bei thermondo.
*Die Entscheidung zum konkreten Gehaltsniveau wird im laufenden Recruitingprozesses definiert und richtet sich nach Deiner Erfahrung, Qualifikation und dem Verantwortungsumfang innerhalb der genannten Position.

**Vor der Einladung zu einem ersten Gespräch nutzen wir ein KI-gestütztes Tool, das unser Recruiting-Team beim initialen Screening unterstützt und zusätzliche Hinweise zu den Anforderungen der jeweiligen Position liefert. Die Entscheidung über den weiteren Verlauf Deiner Bewerbung treffen immer unsere Recruiter:innen und die zuständigen Hiring Manager:innen.

jobs.description:

… als Senior Product Manager:in Service Cockpit entwickelst du einen intern getesteten Prototypen zu einer produktiven Anwendung weiter. Damit können unsere Servicetechniker:innen Wärmepumpen aus der Ferne prüfen, Fehler schneller eingrenzen und sichere Einstellungen vornehmen.
Dein Ziel: weniger Vor-Ort-Einsätze und ein Werkzeug, das im Servicealltag wirklich hilft.

Du verbindest Daten aus verschiedenen Herstellerwelten und baust das Produkt selbst, mit AI als deinem Entwicklungsteam. Du spezifizierst, gestaltest, baust, bringst es live und betreibst es.   • ein kanonisches Datenmodell für unsere eigene Wärmepumpenplattform sowie die Systeme von Buderus und LG zu definieren und mit unserem Datenteam umzusetzen

jobs.title: Product Designer (Experimentation) (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission

We're looking for a designer who decides with evidence. Most design roles stop at the handover. This one does not. You will design a part of the product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and read the results yourself. If you have ever shipped a redesign and never really found out whether it worked, this is the opposite of that.

You will sit inside one product delivery leadership team, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it – not off to one side taking requests. And you will not be doing it alone: you join a group of Product Designers across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards.

English is our working language. German matters here too: you will be designing flows that German-speaking neighbours read.

Concretely, you will:

  • Design experiences that fit how people already live. Our product mirrors real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that feel natural to someone standing on their doorstep with one hand on their phone, not to add features because we can.
  • Frame the real problem before solving it. Take a vague ask, find the actual question underneath it, and make it explainable. A well framed problem to solve is half the battle.
  • Run the experiment, and read it honestly. Design a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome with our data team. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, which is most of them, and saying what you would do differently.
  • Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.
  • Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts. AI produces a lot of our first-pass design. You will brief it, push back on it, and hold the quality bar, so your own hours go to the thinking a model cannot do. Polish goes where it changes behaviour, not onto every surface.
  • Argue for cutting things. Adding is easy. You will help decide what earns its place and what should be removed, and be willing to make the case for less.

Your profile

  • You practice design, and you are very comfortable with numbers. You might come from an analyst background and bring a love of design and design thinking, or vice versa.
  • You have technical know-how. You need to be able to construct the pipelines and dashboards yourself, use our experimentation platform, and our design system tooling.

We’re looking for a Senior QA Tester who will be responsible for testing Frontier’s games throughout all phases of development, from pre-production through post-release content.  

In this role, you’ll work on medium-to-high-risk features, designing and executing comprehensive test suites, and conducting both regression testing and playtesting. Leveraging QA experience, you’ll proactively identify and resolve issues, provide guidance to QA team members and recommend and implement improvements.  

Depending on project needs, you may also assume Assistant Lead or Team Lead responsibilities for specific phases or entire projects.

  • Write, run and maintain medium-to-high risk test specifications and suites for new and existing projects, ensuring efficient time reporting and estimates on given tasks and written suites.

  • Envision user stories and gather data with provided instructions. 

  • Identify and report issues in a clear and accurate manner. 

  • Perform regression testing for both internal and external issues.  

  • Act as point of contact for specific features, regularly collaborating with cross-discipline teams to gather and relay relevant information back to QA.  

  • Provide guidance and technical mentoring to other testers, including guidance on their documentation and advanced troubleshooting of other testers on the project. 

  • Raise potential future hurdles for testing, pre-empt problems, and suggest best fixes and ideas for further testing. 

  • Contribute to product information, identification of problem areas and analysis of trends to anticipate and navigate risks. 


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Significant QA experience in the games industry and a strong understanding of QA tools, procedures, methodologies and workflows.

  • Ability to drive innovation and continuous improvement.

jobs.description:
Mission

Airspeed is changing how revenue teams work. Our AI Revenue Orchestration Platform doesn't just analyze conversations — it acts on them. By turning every customer interaction into insight and action, Airspeed Agents help teams close gaps, move faster, and focus on what matters most: selling.

With 100+ SaaS customers and 90%+ adoption among reps, Airspeed is setting a new standard for execution at scale.

The Role

We're hiring a Finance & Operations Lead to build the financial and operational foundations that will support Airspeed's next stage of growth. You'll own our finance engine, company reporting, and core operating systems — helping make Airspeed easier to run and its decisions better.

This is a senior, hands-on role built for a high-performance operator who can move from financial modeling and board reporting to improving workflows and building scalable systems.

You'll report directly to the CEO and work closely with both founders and every functional leader.

This is not a conventional Chief of Staff, strategy-only, or back-office finance role. It's a builder-operator role for someone who takes full ownership of results and uses AI and automation to remove manual work wherever possible.

 

What You'll Own

 

Finance and Reporting:

  • Own the budget, rolling forecast, cash, runway, and scenario planning — giving leadership a clear, trusted view of the company's financial position and future needs.

  • Run a fast and accurate monthly close with our external accounting partners, and produce clear management and board reporting that explains what happened, why it happened, and what requires a decision.

  • Build a trusted view of ARR, bookings, retention, gross margin, burn, headcount, and unit economics, with clear definitions and reconciled data sources.

  • Oversee billing, collections, payroll coordination, expenses, procurement, and vendors, while putting practical controls in place to keep Airspeed ready for fundraising, audit, tax, and diligence.

     

AI, Automation, and Systems:

  • Make Airspeed AI-native in how we operate, not only in what we sell — redesigning recurring workflows with AI agents, automation tools, APIs, and lightweight code.

  • Build dependable operating systems with clean data, exception handling, audit trails, and human approval where needed, and create self-serve workflows that don't depend on you becoming the human router for every request.

  • Measure the impact of automation through speed, accuracy, reporting latency, and manual hours removed, while helping teams use AI safely with sensitive data and high-stakes decisions.

Company Operations:

  • Own the company operating cadence, including planning, KPI reviews, and decision follow-through, ensuring teams have clarity on priorities, ownership, and next steps.

  • Build scalable workflows for purchasing, contracts, onboarding, offboarding, access, and policies, and improve processes that cross team boundaries while keeping ownership clear.

  • Hold external partners and vendors accountable for scope, service, cost, and quality. Step into important gaps when needed, then fix the underlying system so they don't continue to depend on you.

 

What Success Looks Like

  • Leadership and the board trust the numbers and the forward forecast.

  • Close, reporting, forecasting, and planning run on a clear schedule with minimal manual chasing.

  • Core SaaS metrics have clear definitions and reconciled sources.

  • High-volume workflows are automated, monitored, and documented.

  • Airspeed can continue to grow without finance and operations headcount increasing with every layer of complexity.

 

Qualifications

  • Experience in finance, business operations, or a combined role at a scaling B2B SaaS or technology company.

  • Hands-on ownership of planning, forecasting, management reporting, cash, runway, and board materials.

  • A track record of building operating systems, not simply administering existing processes.

  • Strong data and spreadsheet skills, with the ability to connect information across systems and identify when the underlying data can't be trusted.

  • An AI-native working style, with experience using AI to analyze, draft, reconcile, monitor, automate, and execute work.

  • Sound commercial judgment and exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues simply and challenge senior stakeholders when needed.

  • A bias for action: a high-ownership, low-ego operator who is comfortable moving between company-level questions and detailed execution.

  • Comfort working closely across Finance, Sales, Product, Engineering, and other functional teams in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in scale-up finance, finance transformation, consulting, or accounting followed by hands-on operating experience.

  • A professional accounting qualification.

  • Experience working with UK and US entities, subscription revenue, fundraising, or finance automation.

  • Experience at an early-stage startup or another lean, high-growth environment.

  • A passion for AI-native products, agent-driven workflows, and building smarter ways of working.

What We Value

  • Customer obsession and a relentless focus on measurable impact.

  • Team players who raise the bar and help scale processes and best practices.

  • Creative problem-solvers who can turn imperfect information into clear plans and results.

  • Operators who step into important gaps, solve the immediate problem, and then build systems that prevent it from recurring.

Why Join

  • Shape how the whole company operates.

  • Build an AI-native finance and operations function from the ground up.

  • Work directly with the founders and influence major company decisions.

  • Join an international SaaS company at a point where strong foundations can create outsized value.

Benefits & Perks

  • Market-competitive total compensation package with equity (stock options).

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Collaborative, inclusive culture that values growth, learning, and excellence.

How to Apply

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile. Include a short note about one finance or operations workflow you redesigned or automated, what changed, and the measurable impact.

Airspeed is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and support candidates from all backgrounds and experiences. If you're excited to own outcomes, influence how an international AI company operates, and help scale a category-defining platform, we'd love to hear from you.

Our ambitions are backed by leading VCs (Earlybird, Newion) and industry angels as we tackle a billion-dollar opportunity problem in an underdigitized and underserved market.

jobs.title: Senior Application Security Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for our first dedicated Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs, payment flows, and active bug bounties. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows.

  • Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction.

  • Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners.

  • Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting).

  • Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe.

Also, the HQ office is in Berlin, where the team often meets.


Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years in AppSec (or 3+ years plus a strong software engineering/web-pentesting background), with a track record of true ownership.

  • You read and write production code (Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, etc.) and deeply understand web frameworks, CI/CD, and Kubernetes.

  • You have deep knowledge of web and API security, specifically authentication/authorization models (OAuth2, JWT), rate limiting, tenant isolation, IDOR, and XSS.

  • You have strong cloud security fundamentals (GCP preferred), specifically regarding public exposure, secrets hygiene, and WAF rules.

  • You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • Bonus Points: You have experience securing high-volume, multi-tenant B2B APIs and utilizing AI tooling to accelerate triage and review.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

  • You will get a competitive salary.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, articulating clear business value, ROI, and risk reduction while building long-term, influential partnerships across your accounts.

This role is focused on new account acquisition and strategic account expansion, managing sophisticated, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from initial engagement through contract negotiation, close, and post-sale alignment. Lead and Execute Account & Territory Strategy

  • Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans aligned to revenue targets and long-term growth objectives

Strategic Relationship Building

  • Build and expand executive-level relationships across assigned accounts, engaging stakeholders from site level through C-suite

  • Identify and develop decision-makers, champions, influencers, and economic buyers

  • Establish XYZ Reality as a strategic partner, not just a technology vendor

Consultative & Value-Based Selling

  • Lead with a consultative selling approach, deeply understanding customer challenges, delivery risk, and commercial drivers

  • Align XYZ Reality’s AR solution to customer objectives across safety, quality, schedule, and cost control

  • Navigate complex deal structures, including enterprise-level negotiations, procurement processes, and contractual requirements

  • Support and respond to RFPs / formal bid processes where required, partnering closely with internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing, SDRs, Revenue Operations, Professional Services, and Delivery teams to drive new business and expansion

  • Collaborate with construction partners, consultants, and industry stakeholders to drive co-selling opportunities

Market & Competitive Intelligence

  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activity, and market dynamics within mission-critical construction

  • Provide feedback to leadership on product positioning, customer insights, and evolving market needs

Sales Operations & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Salesforce, including opportunities, forecasts, and next steps

  • Analyse sales data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for optimization

You Could Be a Strong Candidate If You Have:

  • Proven experience owning complex, enterprise sales cycles with annual quotas

  • CRM discipline and comfort operating in structured sales processes

The Ideal Candidate:

  • Comfortable engaging senior executives while also operating on site and with delivery teams

  • Proactive, coachable, and energized by building long-term customer relationships

About Nivoda 🚀

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

Our Mission 🎯

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

The Team ⭐️

Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. We're a high-energy, globally distributed group that moves fast, owns outcomes, and genuinely cares about the success of every jewellery business we work with. This is a team that thrives on commercial creativity, deep customer relationships, and relentless execution and we're growing fast.

About the Role 🤔

You are the front of the machine: you take inbound leads and hunt outbound prospects, qualify them fast, and get a demo on the AE's calendar. Your job ends when the demo is booked and confirmed — everything before that moment is yours.

This is a high-velocity, transactional sales role. Think SaaS SDR playbook: tight cadences, high activity volume, sharp qualification, relentless follow-up. You will run multichannel sequences (phone, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn), work a CRM with discipline, and be measured weekly on activity and demos held.

What will you be doing? 😎

  • Work inbound leads within SLA (minutes, not hours) and convert them to booked demos.

  • Build and execute outbound sequences against target retailer lists; personalise at speed, not at leisure.

  • Qualify hard: right buyer type, purchase volume, intent, timeline. Kill bad leads quickly.

  • Book, confirm, and protect the demo — reduce no-shows with reminders and pre-demo touches.

  • Keep the CRM immaculate: every touch logged, every lead dispositioned, pipeline data trustworthy.

  • Feed learnings back: objections heard, messaging that lands, segments that convert.

What do we need from you? 💪

  • 1–3 years in a SaaS or tech-sales SDR/BDR role with a transactional, high-volume motion — short cycles, big numbers, daily intensity.

  • A killer on the phone and crisp in writing; comfortable with 60–80+ meaningful touches a day.

  • Process-driven: you live in cadences and CRM hygiene rather than fighting them.

  • Coachable and resilient — you treat "no" as data and keep the energy up on day 20 of the month, not just day 1.

  • Native or professional proficiency in English and French is required for this role.

  • Jewellery knowledge not required; hunger and rigour are.

Our culture and what we offer 😉

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment. jobs.title: Enablement and Conversion Manager, Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
Location: Remote in Europe

 

About Nivoda 🚀

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

 

Our Mission 🎯

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

 

About the Role 🤔

Conversion is one of the three chokepoints in our revenue organisation. Customers arrive, take the demo, go through KYC, and too many stall before the first purchase, or buy once and never come back. The second purchase is where the product becomes sticky, and getting a merchant there is the hardest 60 days of their life with us.

Fixing that takes two things, and this role owns both. Reps who know the product, the pricing and the playbook cold. And a conversion funnel that is measured, scored and coached rather than hoped for.

 

Function one: enablement

Training and standards

  • Make sure every rep is up to spec and trained, and keep them there.

  • Own the theoretical onboarding of every new rep, SDR, AE and AM alike: what Nivoda sells, to whom, at what price, and how.

  • Set what "up to spec" means for each role and hold the bar.

Documentation and materials

  • Own the product material for every line of business: how it works, who it is for, pricing, take rate and best practice.

  • Keep it current. A rep should never be the last person to find out something changed.

The channel to marketing

  • Act as the link between marketing and the front line. Every campaign is known to the reps in advance, socialised at the all-hands before it lands, not discovered from a customer.

The channel to product

  • Translate the product roadmap into enablement. You do not decide the roadmap. You turn it into what to sell, to whom, and when.

  • When something ships, the reps already know what it is and how to position it.

Function two: conversion

Conversion rests on two things, and this role owns both: the call, and the KYC. A brilliant call that dies in KYC converts nothing, and a clean KYC on a badly run call never gets there.

Call scoring

  • Build the scoring rubrics with the team managers, so the standard is one both sides recognise.

  • Run transcript review and scoring at volume, using Claude to do it.

  • Send the reports out every week, to everyone.

  • Run a weekly leaderboard: the best calls, the scores, winners and losers, visible to the team.

  • Build a personalised coaching plan for every rep, written down and tracked, not delivered verbally and forgotten.

  • Coach in two directions: with the managers so they can coach their own people, and directly with reps where that is faster.

KYC

  • Own the insight generation of what is working and not on the process

  • Hold the accountability of the KYC SLAs, and call it out when they slip.

  • Map the blockers and the escalation paths, and push the fix at the cause rather than the symptom, across sales, product and marketing as needed.

  • Make sure the KYC operators know the rules, and that the rules are written.

  • Train and enable both sides of it: the reps and the operations team.

How we will measure it 💻

  • Conversion through to second purchase at 75% of each new cohort.

  • KYC above 60%, in every geography, not just on the average.

  • Rubric and call scores in place and reported weekly.

  • 80% compliance against the rubric, reached by your fourth month in the role.

What do we need from you? 💪

  • Experience in sales enablement, revenue operations or frontline sales coaching in a transactional, high-volume environment.

  • You have scored calls at volume and can show what changed as a result. Gong or equivalent.

  • You are fluent with AI tooling and would run transcript review and scoring through Claude rather than by hand.

  • You have built onboarding for reps from scratch, not just delivered someone else's deck.

  • You can coach a manager, not just a rep. You are comfortable telling a senior person their team's calls are not good enough, and then showing them how to fix it.

  • You write clearly. A large part of the value here is documentation other people can pick up and use.

  • You work across Product, Marketing and Finance without authority over any of them.

  • Hands-on. This is not a strategy seat. You will be on calls, in the CRM and in the material every week.

Nice to have ✨

  • Experience with onboarding or activation motions rather than pure new business.

  • Diamonds, jewellery, or another supply-driven marketplace.

  • A second language relevant to EMEA or North America.

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

Our Mission 🎯

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

The Team ⭐️

Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. We're a high-energy, globally distributed group that moves fast, owns outcomes, and genuinely cares about the success of every jewellery business we work with. This is a team that thrives on commercial creativity, deep customer relationships, and relentless execution and we're growing fast.

About the Role 🤔

You are the front of the machine: you take inbound leads and hunt outbound prospects, qualify them fast, and get a demo on the AE's calendar. Your job ends when the demo is booked and confirmed — everything before that moment is yours.

This is a high-velocity, transactional sales role. Think SaaS SDR playbook: tight cadences, high activity volume, sharp qualification, relentless follow-up. You will run multichannel sequences (phone, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn), work a CRM with discipline, and be measured weekly on activity and demos held.

What will you be doing? 😎

  • Work inbound leads within SLA (minutes, not hours) and convert them to booked demos.

  • Build and execute outbound sequences against target retailer lists; personalise at speed, not at leisure.

  • Qualify hard: right buyer type, purchase volume, intent, timeline. Kill bad leads quickly.

  • Book, confirm, and protect the demo — reduce no-shows with reminders and pre-demo touches.

  • Keep the CRM immaculate: every touch logged, every lead dispositioned, pipeline data trustworthy.

  • Feed learnings back: objections heard, messaging that lands, segments that convert.

What do we need from you? 💪

  • 1–3 years in a SaaS or tech-sales SDR/BDR role with a transactional, high-volume motion — short cycles, big numbers, daily intensity.

  • A killer on the phone and crisp in writing; comfortable with 60–80+ meaningful touches a day.

  • Process-driven: you live in cadences and CRM hygiene rather than fighting them.

  • Coachable and resilient — you treat "no" as data and keep the energy up on day 20 of the month, not just day 1.

  • Native or professional proficiency in English and Italian is required for this role.

  • Jewellery knowledge not required; hunger and rigour are.

Our culture and what we offer 😉

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment.   • Construire une roadmap Salesforce à court, moyen et long terme.

  • Profil à la fois fonctionnel et technique

  • Bonne compréhension des enjeux métiers, data et processus

Reporting directly to the Chief Customer Officer, you will lead selected business development priorities and support the broader Customer Development team in accelerating CXG's growth across Europe. 

Who we are 

Founded in 2006, we are a global business with a presence in 12 offices across four continents, serving over 200 luxury clients with a team of 250 professionals.  

At CXG, we are passionate about evolving, elevating, and transforming experiences to bring brand promises to life. We offer strategic solutions that impact performance and elevate the customer and employee experience for some of the world's most iconic premium and luxury brands.

What you will be doing 

Your primary mandate will be to open and develop high-value opportunities within specific priority verticals, named accounts, and strategic growth initiatives defined by the Chief Customer Officer. You will bring a strong hunter mindset and an established network within the luxury and premium ecosystem, while working closely with the existing Customer Development team to strengthen our pipeline, respond to strategic opportunities, and position CXG as a long-term partner.  

Your daily tasks will involve: 

  • Translating the strategic growth priorities defined by the Chief Customer Officer into focused business development plans for selected verticals, markets, and target accounts. 
  • Leveraging your established network and market credibility to secure access to senior decision-makers and create new opportunities with high-potential luxury and premium brands. 
  • Building and maintaining a qualified new-business pipeline, with a strong focus on originating new relationships, opening doors, and converting priority prospects into clients. 
  • Supporting the wider Customer Development team on strategic pursuits, including account research, opportunity qualification, pitch preparation, and coordinated responses to requests for proposal and competitive tenders. 
  • Leading the full commercial cycle for assigned opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through proposal development, tender response, negotiation, and closing. 
  • Designing compelling, insight-driven and commercially sound proposals that articulate CXG's differentiated value, with appropriate pricing, margin, scope, and contractual alignment.

jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The CEO Office

The CEO Office works with senior leaders across Checkout.com on high-priority strategic and operational problems. The team turns important questions into clear decisions, coordinated execution and measurable business outcomes.

The role

This is a manager-level individual-contributor role for a hands-on operator. You will own defined, high-priority, cross-functional initiatives end to end—from framing problems and aligning stakeholders to implementing solutions and delivering measurable outcomes.

Working closely with the Head of the CEO Office, you will combine structured problem-solving with hands-on execution. You will translate priorities into coordinated action, strengthen how teams operate and drive initiatives through to impact.

This is neither a traditional PMO nor a presentation-led strategy role, and it is not an executive-level position. Success requires sound judgement, analytical rigour, clear communication, operational follow-through and the ability to influence effectively without formal authority.

How You'll Make an Impact (Role overview)

  • Support the CEO and Head of the CEO Office on critical cross-functional initiatives by helping coordinate day-to-day delivery, stakeholder collaboration and progress towards measurable outcomes.

  • Help investigate complex, ambiguous problems by clarifying the problem, developing practical solutions and supporting the implementation of durable processes or systems.

  • Support departments in scaling by contributing to organisation design, objectives and KPI setting, and the development of robust operating processes.

  • Assist leadership in navigating ambiguity by surfacing insights, decisions and risks, coordinating follow-through and supporting alignment across teams, particularly where there is no natural owner.

  • Projects may include organisational model design, international expansion strategy, scaling new business lines, strategic planning and goal setting, go-to-market execution, regulatory, data and financial infrastructure initiatives, and supporting board and shareholder reporting.

What We're Looking For (Background and core competencies)

  • Relevant background and impact: Experience in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.Relevant backgrounds include consulting, high-growth technology, investing, investment banking, strategic finance or entrepreneurial operations. Payments or fintech exposure and international experience are advantages.

  • Problem-solving and analytical rigour: Use first-principles thinking, data and judgement to structure ambiguous problems, identify key measures and move between strategic questions and operational detail. Advanced SQL or hands-on data analysis is a plus.

  • Building and execution: Turn analysis into practical plans, KPIs, processes, tools or systems that create durable value. Experience building low-code/no-code or AI automations that others continue to use is a plus.

  • Ownership and impact: Personally own cross-functional work and deliver measurable outcomes.

  • Influence and collaboration: Build trust, navigate trade-offs and make progress across functions without formal authority, with a low-ego and collaborative approach.

  • Learning agility and entrepreneurial mindset: Learn quickly, respond well to feedback, adapt to changing priorities and show evidence of creating, launching or materially improving something from scratch. Founding or entrepreneurial experience is valued but not required.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
Finance & Reconciliation Analyst / Safeguarding
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Finance & Reconciliations Analyst to join our Safeguarding function at Pleo.

In this role, you'll be at the heart of how we meet our safeguarding obligations under FCA rules. You'll perform daily and periodic reconciliations across customer funds, balances and transactions, contribute to process improvement initiatives, and support our external audit activity. You'll also help produce the management information that feeds into our governance oversight. If you're genuinely curious about payments and financial infrastructure, good with data, and keen to learn and improve as you go, then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

Who you'll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to our Head of Safeguarding and work closely with teams across Finance Operations, Compliance, and Product.

Our Finance function is dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of safeguarding and financial control. You'll also have the opportunity to partner with colleagues across our operations, audit, and leadership teams to help drive strong governance and regulatory compliance.

What you'll be doing

As a Finance & Reconciliations Analyst in Safeguarding, you will:

  • Perform and support the review of daily and periodic safeguarding reconciliations across customer funds, balances and transactions

  • Monitor reconciliation outputs and carry out post-review checks and manual follow-up activity

  • Investigate breaks and exceptions, escalating where needed and tracking issues through to resolution

  • Maintain accurate records, supporting documentation and clear audit trails

  • Help collate and prepare management information on reconciliations and exceptions for governance forums including the Safeguarding Committee

  • Work with data in spreadsheets and internal systems to extract, check and present information clearly

  • Spot patterns in exceptions or recurring issues and flag them to the team

  • Contribute to reconciliations-related projects, including system changes, tooling improvements and process redesign

  • Flag inefficiencies or recurring control weaknesses and bring forward practical ideas to address them

  • Support the development and automation of reporting processes over time

  • Help prepare and organise documentation, evidence packs and reconciliation outputs for external audit

  • Respond to auditor queries and requests in a timely and accurate manner

What you bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 2+ years of experience in a reconciliations, payments, finance operations or similar role

  • Comfort working with data and spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel) and a keen interest to develop further

  • A methodical and accurate approach — you take care with the details and notice when something doesn't look right

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain what you've found clearly to colleagues and, where needed, to external auditors

  • Genuine interest in how financial services and payments regulation works in practice

  • A passion for solving problems in practical and innovative ways

  • Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise tasks effectively

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You're genuinely curious about fintech and how payments infrastructure actually works

  • You enjoy working with data and understanding systems, not just using them

  • You're excited by the responsibility of maintaining financial controls and regulatory compliance

  • You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy improving processes and ways of working

  • You bring a self-starter attitude — you don't wait to be told what to do next

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You struggle working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities

  • You do not enjoy detailed analytical or investigative work

  • You prefer working in isolation rather than collaborating with colleagues across teams

  • You're not interested in the practical application of financial regulation

How you'll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Develop a strong understanding of Pleo's safeguarding obligations under FCA rules, including the CASS and DFSA safeguarding requirements. Learn how our reconciliation processes work across all our systems and develop expertise in carrying out and reviewing reconciliations

  • Collaborate with colleagues to help improve and streamline our reconciliation and reporting processes

  • Grow your skills in data handling, financial analysis, and audit preparation

  • Take on new challenges as you build confidence and the company continues to scale

We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into process improvement leadership, or acquiring new skills in areas you identify for growth.

The location

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background

  • Hiring Manager: A 45-minute chat with our Head of Safeguarding & Reconciliation

  • Pleo challenge: A 60-minute chat with peers and/or stakeholders to check how you would think and act in the role. Expect some real life examples as well as on the spot challenges

  • Final Interview: A 30-minute final chat with one of our senior stakeholders

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we're looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a significant number of applications but only a fraction were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn't make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.
